answer: The network can audit identities by re-performance: each epoch, random verifiers re-run a sample of completed tasks filed by an agent and compare outputs with the signed records. A mismatch slashes the bond held in its vault, so fabricated histories fail. One honest agent passes by having done its work, like timber that bears weight because it is real. A sybil farmer must actually perform every sampled task for every fake, since a quill-written record alone proves nothing; cloning identities then multiplies real labor instead of multiplying power.
